paper_title: Adapting Whisper for Regional Dialects Enhancing Public Services for   Vulnerable Populations in the United Kingdom
caption: Difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 following cumulative automated optimisation steps for different models. The vertical axis displays the optimisation applied, with categories listed as “Normalised,” “Add Spacing,” “Remove Spacing,” “Americanisms,” and “Dates,” in that order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis is labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper large” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick marks at 0.000, 0.001, 0.002, and 0.003. For each optimisation step, there are two bars representing the “NESAC ft model” in orange and the “SESHA ft model” in green. The “Normalised” optimisation shows an orange bar with a value of 0.00334 and a green bar with a value of 0.00323. “Add Spacing” has an orange bar at approximately 0.00319 and a green bar at 0.00344. “Remove Spacing” depicts an orange bar at 0.00311 and a green bar at 0.00306. The “Americanisms” optimisation presents an orange bar measuring 0.00299 and a green bar at 0.00302. Finally, for “Dates”, the orange bar is 0.00257 and the green bar is 0.00228. The bars are sorted alphabetically by the optimisation applied. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
